name: HyNote
description_en:
HyNote turns recordings, meetings, documents, images and links into searchable AI-assisted notes. It supports capture, transcription, summary templates and transfer to other tools, with separate plan conditions for recording minutes, real-time transcription and exports.

It is an input-to-summary workflow rather than just a blank notebook. The same account must be used across devices, and the current pricing FAQ distinguishes web live-transcription languages from the broader mobile offering.
description_zh:
HyNote 把录音、会议、文档、图片和链接整理为可搜索的 AI 辅助笔记，支持采集、转录、摘要模板及向其他工具传递内容。录音分钟数、实时转录与导出有各自的套餐条件。

它属于从输入材料到摘要的工作流，不只是空白笔记本。跨设备需要使用同一账户；当前定价 FAQ 还区分网页实时转录语言和范围更广的移动端。

core_features.explanation_en: Audio, documents, images and links can feed note generation.
core_features.explanation_zh: 音频、文档、图片和链接可作为笔记生成输入。

core_features.explanation_en: Summaries, key points and action items are generated from sources.
core_features.explanation_zh: 依据来源生成摘要、要点与行动项。

core_features.explanation_en: Transcript export starts at Pro; direct note transfer starts at Plus.
core_features.explanation_zh: 转录导出从 Pro 开放，直接传递笔记从 Plus 开放。

en: Review an interview transcript and export a summary.
Summarise source PDFs alongside meeting notes.
zh: 检查访谈转录并导出摘要。
将来源 PDF 摘要与会议笔记结合。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor account service with web, mobile and documented Apple/Chrome clients.
Deployment.zh: 厂商账户服务，提供 Web、移动端及文档所列 Apple／Chrome 客户端。

steps.en: Sign in with the same Apple/Google account on the intended capture and review devices.
steps.zh: 采集与审阅设备登录同一个 Apple／Google 账户。

steps.en: Capture a permitted sample, inspect the transcript and select a summary template.
steps.zh: 采集获允许的样例，检查转录并选择摘要模板。

steps.en: Confirm the plan allows the desired export and verify the destination copy.
steps.zh: 确认套餐允许所需导出，并核对目标副本。

items.en: HyNote suits evaluating a repeated capture-to-summary-to-export process across meetings and source documents. A simple personal text archive may not need AI or subscription quotas. For a failed capture or export, preserve the original recording/document and check the destination before retrying to avoid losing context or creating duplicate notes; this is editorial handling advice, not a documented transactional recovery guarantee. No self-hosted edition, source licence, accuracy benchmark or independent security audit was verified.
items.zh: 如果需要反复把会议和来源文档采集、摘要并导出，HyNote 值得评估。简单的个人文字归档可能不需要 AI 或订阅额度。采集或导出失败时，建议保留原始录音／文档，重试前核对目标，避免丢失上下文或生成重复笔记；这是编辑建议，不是文档承诺的事务恢复保证。未核实自行部署版、源码许可、准确率基准或独立安全审计。

pricing.billing_basis: Plan and minutes; Teams per seat with two-seat minimum.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Monthly Pro $11.99, Plus $18.99, Unlimited $24.99; annual $79.99/$129.99/$189.99. Teams $20/seat monthly or $180/seat yearly; seven-day individual paid trials.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 按月 Pro 11.99、Plus 18.99、Unlimited 24.99；年费 79.99／129.99／189.99。Teams 按月每席位 20 或年费每席位 180；个人付费档试用七天。

sections.title_zh: 生成摘要前先选择采集方式
sections.en: For a proposed interview workflow, record with permission or upload an existing audio file, inspect the transcript, then produce an interview summary and action items. HyNote also documents PDFs, images/OCR, YouTube and webpage inputs. Check names, speaker attribution and negations against the recording before transferring the result; a polished summary can omit qualifications. This example has not been executed.
sections.zh: 例如整理访谈时，可在获得允许后录音或上传已有音频，检查转录，再生成访谈摘要与行动项。HyNote 还列有 PDF、图片／OCR、YouTube 和网页输入。向外传递前应对照录音核对姓名、发言人和否定表述；流畅的摘要可能漏掉条件。此示例未实际执行。

sections.en: The help centre says notes are tied to the user account and requires identical credentials on every device. Pricing lists free recording/transcription with up to 120 minutes per session. Its FAQ restricts web live transcription to English, French, German, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese while saying mobile supports more. Pro enables transcript export; Plus and above add transfer to Google Docs and Notion. Verify the exact input mode and destination rather than assuming homepage language coverage applies everywhere.
sections.zh: 帮助中心说明笔记绑定用户账户，所有设备必须使用相同凭据。定价页列出免费录音／转录，每次最多 120 分钟。FAQ 把网页实时转录列为英语、法语、德语、西班牙语、意大利语和葡萄牙语，移动端范围更广。Pro 开放转录导出；Plus 及以上增加向 Google Docs、Notion 传递内容。应确认具体输入方式和目标，不能把首页语言范围套到全部功能。

sections.en: The FAQ lists monthly Pro $11.99, Plus $18.99, Unlimited $24.99 and Teams $20/seat; annual totals are $79.99, $129.99, $189.99 and $180/seat respectively. Teams starts at two seats. Pro/Plus/Unlimited offer seven-day trials and annual cards auto-renew. Pro includes 1,200 transcription minutes monthly; Plus separately lists 1,200 real-time minutes. Promotional creation credits are one-time, not monthly. Unlimited real-time transcription still has the stated 120-minute session ceiling.
sections.zh: FAQ 列出按月 Pro 11.99、Plus 18.99、Unlimited 24.99、Teams 每席位 20；对应年费为 79.99、129.99、189.99、每席位 180。Teams 至少两席。Pro／Plus／Unlimited 有七天试用，年度卡片注明自动续费。Pro 每月含 1,200 转录分钟；Plus 另列每月 1,200 实时分钟。宣传的内容制作额度是一次性而非每月。不限量实时转录仍有每次 120 分钟上限。

research_gaps.en: The complete free monthly allowance, regional checkout, capture permissions, transcription quality and export behaviour were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试完整免费月度额度、地区结账、采集权限、转录质量与导出行为。
